notes: FITNESS SF's own locations, named in issue #320, read from each location page on 2026-09-11. https://www.fitnesssf.com/locations names nine gyms but carries no addresses or hours; each location page states both, and two fetches of all seven San Francisco pages the same day were byte-identical. The chain's two other locations are in Corte Madera and Oakland and stay off. The site titles each location 'SF CASTRO', 'SF SOMA' and so on and gives the brand as 'FITNESS SF' (its footer: 'FitnessSF / FITNESS SF is a brand of Jackovics Enterprises, Inc.'); `name` is the issue's spelling of the two together, `name_as_listed` the page's own title. No location page publishes coordinates or schema.org markup, so every address is resolved from the address it prints. The Polk gym is not open: its page says 'GYM OPENING October 2026' over 'Presale Office Now Open!', and the hours it publishes are the presale office's, so that entry's `kinds` says so and its page carries an `unknowns` line rather than reading as an open gym. One referral link covers the whole chain — join.fitnesssf.com with a member code, a free month for the person joining (https://www.fitnesssf.com/referral-program: 'Give a FREE Month, Get a FREE Month') — so there is one REFERRALS row, `fitnesssf`, and one source id for all seven pages.

coverage.remaining: None; every San Francisco location is here. The other two, Corte Madera (Marin) and Oakland, are outside the city.

resolution.method: By hand: sf-eas-addresses has no street named EMBARCADERO CENTER at all — the registry spells the waterfront street THE EMBARCADERO and holds no 2 THE EMBARCADERO either, filing parcel 0231023 under 201 CLAY ST. The 2025 roll names the parcel '0000 0002 THE EMBARCADERO', commercial office, built 1974, 35 stories on a 75,625 sq ft lot, and sf-parcels has blklot 0231023 active with mapblklot 0231023 — one parcel, not a condominium stack. DBI confirms the tenancy on the parcel itself: permit 'fire alarm work for the fitness sf' on the 1st floor is filed at 2 Embarcadero Center under block 0231, lot 023. The page goes under the Embarcadero Center hub at the complex's own number, as 4 Embarcadero Center (parcel 0233044, which EAS files as 150 DRUMM ST) already is.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed. Its `unknowns` says how the listing's address and the city's records differ.

publish.note: An `occupants` entry on /san-francisco/financial-district/embarcadero-center/2/, whose `unknowns` says the registry files the parcel as 201 Clay Street and the roll as 2 The Embarcadero.

resolution.method: By hand: sf-eas-addresses has no 1 10TH ST, and the only parcel carrying a 10th Street number below 40 is 3507041, 8–18 10TH ST, across the street. DBI places the gym instead: three permits naming 'fitness sf' — one for 'mechanical & electrical as part of expansion of fitness sf into adjacent space', two for ground-floor fire alarm work — are filed at 875 Stevenson St under block 3508, lot 039. sf-parcels has blklot 3508039 active, mapblklot 3508039, 875–875 STEVENSON; EAS holds 875 STEVENSON ST on it; the 2025 roll records it as commercial office, built 1975, 10 stories on a 39,650 sq ft lot. The parcel's southwest edge fronts 10th Street opposite 8–18 10TH ST, so '1 10th Street' is this building's door on that frontage, under a number the city's registry does not carry.

publish.note: An `occupants` entry on /san-francisco/south-of-market/stevenson-street/875/, whose `unknowns` says the city's registry has no 1 10th Street and that DBI files the gym at 875 Stevenson Street.
